prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Real estate isa
A real estate inside sales agent (ISA) is in charge of lead generation and adding qualified leads to the sales funnel. This type of outbound real estate agent is responsible for prospecting new leads and cultivating potential clients for their real estate team. An ISA typically works at a real estate agency.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m passionate about helping teams stay organized, consistent, and focused on the right opportunities, and I bring a hard-working approach to every role I take on.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience working with data analysis, data cleaning, data visualization, dashboards, and reporting tools such as SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. While my background is rooted in data work, I’m confident that the same discipline, structure, and attention to detail that support strong analytics also translate well into a real estate ISA role where lead generation, follow-up, and lead qualification are critical.

What stands out to me about this position is the importance of identifying promising leads, keeping the sales funnel moving, and supporting the real estate team with reliable outbound prospecting. I understand that success in an ISA role depends on persistence, communication, organization, and the ability to stay focused on high-value conversations. I’m comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, following processes carefully, and maintaining consistent outreach efforts.

I also bring a strong analytical mindset, which can be useful when tracking lead quality, spotting patterns, and staying organized across multiple prospects. I’m skilled at working with spreadsheets and structured data, so I can manage lead information accurately and keep records clean and easy to use. That kind of organization helps ensure no opportunity is overlooked and that the sales funnel remains current and actionable.

If selected, I would approach the role with professionalism, energy, and a commitment to learning your team’s workflow quickly. I’m reliable, adaptable, and motivated to contribute in a way that supports both lead generation and long-term growth. I’d welcome the opportunity to bring my experience, work ethic, and detail-oriented approach to your real estate team.
